Key asks: support for very long context windows (40k+ tokens for multi-file context), predictable rate limiting (burst to 50 req/s, steady 20 req/s), client SDKs (first-class JS + Go + types), streaming partial token delivery for editor experience, and a straightforward predictable pricing model.
